task_name: Deploy and Configure a Monitoring System for Linux Servers
task_description: Deploy Nagios monitoring system across multiple RHEL/Linux servers in a VMware virtualized environment. Configure monitoring checks, set up alerts, automate deployment with shell scripts, and manage user access.

monitoring_capability.description: Monitoring capability (Nagios OR general monitoring tools)

technical_foundation.description: Technical foundation (troubleshooting and networking both important)

core_competency.description: Core competency (must have core Linux AND monitoring)

platform_skills.description: Platform skills (platform knowledge and automation both important)

supporting_skills.description: Supporting skills (system management AND technical foundation)

final_score.description: Final compatibility (core competency AND platform skills AND supporting skills)
